//: Facing for public-room seats whose tile NAME carries no _dir_N, where the default (perpendicular to the bench, toward the floor's centre; tools/extract-room-seats.mjs) is wrong. Per room: seat tile ref -> direction (server clockwise index: 1 = up-right, 3 = down-right, 5 = down-left, 7 = up-left), or "*" for the whole room. Rooms whose layout names no seats at all (Town Square) list hand-placed seats under "add": tile ref -> direction, or -> { "dir": N, "item": 86 } for a seat that is not height 10 (66). Checked against the room art in logs/room-doorways.html (tools/render-room-doorways.mjs).
